approvalBasis: User delegated visual choice and authorized implementation; selected for board prominence plus persistent, non-overlapping chat.
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: desktop web app composition concept for TurnUp.io live six-player Ludo room. Primary request: THE GAME KIT direction, flat frontal production UI screenshot, not an illustration poster. Screen regions: a slim utility top bar with TurnUp wordmark, room code, connection status; a very large centered six-sided Ludo playfield taking 68% of width and 80% of available height, with six equally sized player homes and six radial paths to a center; a narrow right column with the six players in compact list, clear current turn and one Roll Dice button; a slim bottom-right CHAT panel with three actual messages and a message input, separated from a two-event match log. Chat is required and clearly usable without covering the board. The board stays the focal point. Visual world: dark navy felt-lined modular tabletop case, precisely printed ivory cells, six muted jewel player colors, tactile pawns, warm amber action accent, compact modern sans typography, carefully proportioned printed score labels. No marketing copy, no shop, no floating dialog, no fake charts, no cards within cards. Explicitly keep text and controls as a realistic web UI and do not treat this as a photographed board. The paths need only communicate the six-sided arrangement, not exact rules geometry.
